name: Hab and Gut
summary: Industrial barons trade commodity shares with insider market tips while donating to charity to avoid elimination at final scoring.
rules_text: Board tracks prices of 6 commodities starting at 40. Each round, market cards are dealt 8 per player into holders between players; each player sees only the two adjacent holders. Each round has 4 turns, each turn has two phases in clockwise order from start player. Stock phase: act or pass. You may buy up to 3 shares or sell up to 3 shares at current board prices, not both. Then you may place one owned share face-down on your charity board. Market manipulation phase: you must pick one card to play from one adjacent holder and one card to halve from the other holder. Play moves price up/down by full number, halve moves by half rounded, capped by board. Discard cards. After 4 turns round ends, charity shares are revealed, sold at current prices and money stays on charity board. Shuffle market deck and start round 2, prices carry over. At game end, sell remaining charity shares, player(s) with least total charity money are eliminated, then remaining players sell personal shares; richest remaining wins.
